venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL 8/28 (Fri) — MOD: Mk/Jk — Net $7,337 vs target $6,112 (+20.0%).** Second to last Summer Friday. Chill start with familiar faces — investors Kevin & Liz in again. Fully staffed; first pop 10-11pm. New outdoor tables in place; reminder to keep rounds going outside. Kitchen: keep communication open. No 86s, no maintenance needs. Comps $93.10. Guests 273 / $26.88 check avg. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH 8/28 (Fri) — MOD: KE/DJ — Net $10,695 vs target $10,421 (+2.6%).** Decent night: afternoon pop, slower early evening, steady-to-busy 9:30pm-midnight, then Charmers' close sent their end-of-night business over — great neighbors vocalizing we're still open at their last call. Kitchen smooth. Low on brine. Comps $57 / 0.5%. Guests 388 / $27.57 avg. Tuesday regulars Thomas & Andy came in on a weekend for the first time. Entered by Bt.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR 8/28 (Fri) — AM MOD: Maggie S & Josh / PM MOD: Carey & Lucas — Net $18,860.37 vs target $17,746 (+6.3%).** DC/AM $1,369.67; D&C PM $17,445.38; Garden/6A $3,976.04. Food $3,193.50. Strangely slow Friday downstairs (possibly Broncos game) with a light 10pm pop, but team made great sales with the guests on hand; Garden slow start then nice busy evening. Kitchen chill and steady. Comps $479.55 / 2.55%. Guests 380 (Tock). Maintenance flagged to TRH: stone falling off around FroSpro machine, pipe under Bar 01, grill bottom. Top-notch teamwork. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA 8/28 (Fri) — MOD: Gigi & Joe / Josh & Saleh — Net $12,160 vs target $11,745 (+3.5%).** Very steady evening; slower start then found rhythm after 8pm with first rush to 10pm. Marquee full ($9,275 / $1,700 food); Standing Room fluctuated ($2,885 / $600 food). SR fizzled by midnight; smooth close. Very high food sales ($2,300) — fantastic kitchen night. Vic's last day after 4 years (team shots in comps: $564.32 incl. members, DNLs x4, service recovery). Guests 294 / $93.49 avg. Flood lights/exit sign near host cove out. No-shows charged. Entered by Gigi.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG 8/28 (Fri) — AM: Braden & Lex / PM: Justin & Shannon/Marcus — Net $8,813 vs target $13,000 (-32.2%).** Rain kept streets quiet. Municipal Bar AM $1,729 (57 guests, slow breakfast, solid lunch); PM $5,335 (161 guests, nearly full 7:30-9pm then slow decline). Sun Club $15 — shut down early due to rain. Hot Eye $2,200 — full house by 10pm, steady to 11:30, bachelorettes and large parties, high energy. Kitchen easy; hoped-for rush never came; R&D chat for menu flip; one butterscotch gelato return (DNL). Comps $548. Hot Eye men's bathroom leaking again. Entered by Alexis.
